weight_orientation: out = W @ input + b; columns are examples
input_features: 0:64: 8x8 binary mask rolled by (-anchor_y,-anchor_x), flattened in C row-major order; map 0 to -1 and 1 to +1
prediction: For output o, eta0*Js coefficient = output_scale*(o[0]+i*o[1])*exp(i*2*pi*(m*x+n*y)); inactive metal basis coefficients are zero.
polarizer_similarity: canonical_frequency_GHz = physical_frequency_GHz*period_m/0.02. Masks are expressed in principal u/v coordinates; translated modal excitations multiply each incident column by exp(i*q_mn dot shifts_ref_m). The u/v-to-lab matrix is in the geometry file.
